title: Surreal Eye of Creativity
description: A surreal painting featuring a large central eye with a pink iris and black pupil containing a small figure. Above it are two facing profile faces in purple and pink with green vine-like hair, a yellow camera on the forehead, and a floating bowl of orange flowers. Below, a red patterned cloth holds another yellow camera, surrounded by floating orange slices, autumn leaves, and black swirling vines against a deep red background with a faint cityscape silhouette.
prompt: Surreal symbolic artwork with a large central pink eye containing a tiny figure, two facing profile faces in purple and pink with swirling green vine hair, a small yellow camera between the faces, another yellow camera resting on a red patterned cloth below, floating orange slices and autumn leaves on black swirling vines, a purple bowl with orange flowers and red ribbon floating above, faint city silhouette in the background, vibrant contrasting colors on a deep red field.
